site.name: Binh Minh Tofu
site.address: 1180 Tully Rd, Suites A, B, and C, San Jose, CA 95122

observations.section: Current Good Manufacturing Practice (21 CFR Part 117, Subpart B)
observations.title: Improper cooling of cooked tofu creates food safety hazard
observations.summary: FDA observed that the cooling process for freshly made tofu did not achieve required temperature reductions, and the firm failed to provide supporting data.

observations.section: Current Good Manufacturing Practice (21 CFR Part 117, Subpart B)
observations.title: Inadequate cleaning and sanitation of utensils and equipment
observations.summary: The firm did not clean and sanitize food‑contact surfaces in accordance with 21 CFR 117.35(a) and failed to demonstrate effective sanitation per 21 CFR 117.35(d).

observations.section: Current Good Manufacturing Practice (21 CFR Part 117, Subpart B)
observations.title: Employee hygienic practices not adequate
observations.summary: Employees touched food‑contact surfaces with gloved hands, handled sticky equipment, and wore jewelry, indicating insufficient hygienic practices.

observations.section: Current Good Manufacturing Practice (21 CFR Part 117, Subpart B)
observations.title: Equipment and utensils not designed for proper cleaning
observations.summary: Several pieces of equipment, including piping, molds, and containers, had cracks, rough welds, or design flaws that prevent adequate cleaning and sanitation.

observations.section: Current Good Manufacturing Practice (21 CFR Part 117, Subpart B)
observations.title: Facility conditions unsanitary and in disrepair
observations.summary: Floors were worn with standing water, walls had openings, doorframes were decaying, and paint was peeling, creating conditions that could adulterate food.

observations.title: Product contains undeclared artificial color additive
observations.summary: Fresh Tofu Pudding with Ginger Syrup (pandan flavor) is misbranded because it contains an artificial coloring not declared on the label.

observations.title: False or misleading labeling of Daily Fresh Soybean Cake
observations.summary: The label for Daily Fresh Soybean Cake “fresh tofu” makes false or misleading statements about the product.

observations.title: Nutrition labeling does not meet RACC requirements
observations.summary: The serving size for Fresh Tofu Pudding with Ginger Syrup is not based on the Reference Amount Customarily Consumed as required by 21 CFR 101.9(b)(2).

observations.title: Labeling fails to meet finishing statement requirements
observations.summary: Several products are misbranded because the label does not contain the required finishing statement.

observations.title: Label claims not supported by evidence
observations.summary: Multiple products are misbranded because the label makes claims that are not substantiated.

observations.title: Label missing common or usual name
observations.summary: FDA found the Fresh Tofu Pudding with Ginger Syrup (pandan flavor) label does not bear the common or usual name of the food, violating section 403(i)(1) of the FD&C Act and 21 CFR 101.4.
